GenAiPlugin.description: Use this topic when librarians request a privacy-safe summary of an authorized member's information without exposing sensitive authentication or security details.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the request is for information about a specific member, use LibraryAgentMemberSummaryAction.
Ensure that no authentication, security fields, or sensitive data is included in the response.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only provide authorized, privacy-safe summaries of selected members' information. Do not expose or process authentication details, security fields, or personal passwords.
